name: codex-tasklist
description: Persistent Codex CLI task queue with native terminal panels and automatic tmux setup

interface.shortDescription: A persistent task queue below Codex across terminals.
interface.longDescription: Track user requests with stable IDs, live statuses, scrolling and adjustable panel height. Native terminal integrations and a simple launcher with tmux fallback. Local storage; task commands work without a panel.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show and maintain the task list for this session.
